page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-8-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor based on the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. For local storage, it includes a bundled 402 GB NVMe SSD, while containing no GPU accelerators.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong single-core CPU performance, scoring 2863.28 in stress-ng tests, which places it in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench scores align with average tier expectations. Memory bandwidth tests reveal a significant performance tradeoff: while small-block cached read bandwidth is average at 565.78 GB/sec, large-block uncached read and write bandwidths drop to weak and poor tiers at 36.05 GB/sec and 13.63 GB/sec respectively.

Given its balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio and integrated high-speed NVMe SSD, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring local scratch space without the overhead of network-attached storage. It is well-suited for general-purpose applications, software compilation, text processing, and database operations that fit within its 32 GB memory limit.
